checks.name: lost response retry
checks.evidence: The synthetic API persisted the response then disconnected. Retry produced two POST attempts with the same idempotency key and exactly one stored proof.

checks.name: stored response reload
checks.evidence: After browser reload, GET lesson evidence restored the proof; selecting it fetched the stored inline body and displayed the exact synthetic lesson 12 response.

checks.name: full schedule
checks.evidence: The existing project sidebar displayed all 16 server-supplied sessions and completed/current/locked labels.

checks.name: lesson 11 to 12 scope
checks.evidence: Completion POST targeted session 11 with planRevision 1 and a selected server proof, then reconcile and context refresh updated lesson 12. Old unsaved draft, assessment result, and selected proofs cleared. Session 12 evidence was loaded; the next response POST targeted session 12. Tutor session reads stayed at the two initial reads throughout assessment, publish, completion and response saves; no session recreation occurred.

checks.name: formal assessment feedback
checks.evidence: The formal assessment form loaded an owner-shaped synthetic question, submitted the learner response to the answers route, and displayed the returned full explanation and result. The fixture deliberately kept TheoryMastered false.

checks.name: experiment fullscreen and parameter preview
checks.evidence: The registered optics component entered native fullscreen (document.fullscreenElement and is-fullscreen class confirmed). Increasing slit width from 50 to 55 micrometers changed the model-computed central width from 25.31 to 23.01 mm. Preview did not issue an evidence-save request.

checks.name: teacher immutable version review
checks.evidence: Existing student detail drawer showed bound version 1 text and excluded a later version 2. Decision stayed disabled until the read checkbox was checked. The UI submitted the existing review decision route with a stable key and displayed the read-back approved state.

checks.name: student publish after teacher approval
checks.evidence: Reading an approved but submitted report exposed Publish reviewed work. The UI called the existing artifact publish route, refreshed proofs, called reconcile, and displayed published plus approved proof state.

boundaries: No production API, database, model, credentials, or real learner data were used.
These results do not verify model quality, owner authorization, mastery grading, or production readiness. Backend owner tests are reported separately by the parent agent.
Synthetic assessment and report approval receipts were explicit fixtures, not real AI judgments or teacher records.
Existing binary UI assets were copied for local execution only; they are not implementation changes.
Agent-browser required scrolling controls into the nested chat viewport before coordinate clicks. Initial offscreen clicks did not submit requests.

One synthetic fixture reused a report reference for submitted and approved proof, causing a React duplicate-key warning; the real owner uses distinct task_submission and artifact references. This does not represent a backend acceptance test.
browser.cleanup: Both named agent-browser sessions closed; this run's student/teacher dev-server and synthetic-API exec sessions stopped. Ports 34115, 34116 and 34119 verified with no listeners. Existing integration servers were not touched.
